name: nexus_get_mod
description:
Get full details for one mod: description, version, author, and counts [v1 - uses v1 REST quota].

Returns:
    JSON mod info object (mod_id, name, summary, description BBCode, version,
    author, endorsement_count, mod_downloads, created/updated timestamps, ...).
    Server-cached 5 minutes.

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name

mod_id.description: Numeric mod ID from the mod page URL, e.g. 959 for forzahorizon6/mods/959.
mod_id.title: Mod Id
